scenario.content:
# Scenario config. ALL RANGES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS (not calibrated to any real site/event).
seed: 20260001
mode: gradual            # gradual | rapid

run:
  duration_s: 240.0      # simulated seconds (~4 min)
  sample_rate_hz: 10.0
  min_hold_fraction: 0.10   # event must finish by (1 - this) of run, so an aftermath exists

# PLACEHOLDER: physical duration the simulated run stands for.
# compression_factor = physical_duration_s / run.duration_s (stored in metadata)
time_compression:
  gradual: {physical_duration_s: 86400.0}   # PLACEHOLDER: 24 h
  rapid:   {physical_duration_s: 240.0}     # PLACEHOLDER: real time (factor 1)

ranges:                  # PLACEHOLDER ranges
  centre_radii: 1.5            # x0,y0 uniform in network centre +/- this many network radii (per axis)
  sigma_radii: [0.4, 1.5]      # sx, uniform, in network radii. MAIN range: hi is CAPPED at 1.5 (engine rejects >1.5)
  broad_basin_subset: false    # OFF by default. If true, sx upper bound becomes sigma_radii_broad_max (separate subset)
  sigma_radii_broad_max: 2.5   # only used when broad_basin_subset is true
  aspect_sy_over_sx: [1.0, 2.0]
  theta_deg: [0.0, 180.0]      # rotation of the anisotropy axes
  peak_tilt_deg: [0.05, 3.0]   # log-uniform; max surface slope of the final field, anywhere
  t_on_frac: [0.20, 0.50]      # fraction of run
  tau_frac:
    gradual: [0.40, 0.80]      # fraction of run
    rapid:   [0.02, 0.08]
  max_resample: 1000           # (t_on, tau) pair rejected if event would overrun the hold window

mounting:                # PLACEHOLDER magnitudes
  yaw_error_sd_deg: 1.0
  level_offset_sd_deg: 0.02

telemetry_placeholder:   # PLACEHOLDER: not a sensor model
  tilt_noise_sd_deg: 0.02
  seed_offset: 7919

sensor.content:
# Sensor / network model config (SYNTHETIC / SIMULATION).
# Legend:  [PROFILE]     = value is derived from configs/noise_profile.json (real MPU6050/ADS1115 recording)
#          [USER-SPEC]   = value fixed by the project brief
#          [PLACEHOLDER] = invented, NOT calibrated to anything. Replace when real data exists.
# All times are SIMULATED seconds. Sensor timing is NOT rescaled by the time-compression factor.

window_s: 1.0                    # telemetry window / IMU sample period. [PROFILE] real sampling_interval_sec = 1.013, rounded

imu:                             # MPU6050
  noise_multiplier_range: [0.5, 2.0]   # [USER-SPEC] per-run log-uniform multiplier on white noise and drift step
  white_sd_from_profile: true          # [PROFILE] white sd = mean over NODE_01..03 of continuous_step_noise / sqrt(2*(1-autocorr_lag1)), per field; same value for all 4 nodes
  node_bias_sd_deg: 0.05               # [PLACEHOLDER] static per-node bias sd, per axis
  drift_sd_deg_per_sqrt_s: 0.002       # [PLACEHOLDER] random-walk bias drift, sd per sqrt(sim second)

piezo:                           # ADS1115 piezo channel
  baseline_from_profile: true          # [PROFILE] rms median, lognormal sigma from mean/std, AR(1) phi = lag-1 autocorr, peak/rms and p2p/peak medians
  node_gain_sd_ln: 0.15                # [PLACEHOLDER] per-node lognormal gain spread
  crest_scatter_ln: 0.15               # [PLACEHOLDER] window-to-window scatter of peak/rms
  p2p_scatter_ln: 0.10                 # [PLACEHOLDER] scatter of p2p/peak
  impulse_rate_per_s: 0.01             # [PLACEHOLDER] background impulse events per node per second
  impulse_amp_median: 0.03             # [PLACEHOLDER] impulse peak amplitude (same unit as piezo_peak)
  impulse_amp_sigma_ln: 0.5            # [PLACEHOLDER]
  impulse_rms_fraction: 0.35           # [PLACEHOLDER] rms contribution of an impulse = fraction * peak amplitude
  adc_full_scale: 4.096                # ADS1115 +/-4.096 V range (datasheet, gain 1); used only to define "implausible" readings

lidar:                           # hub scanning range sensor. ALL FIVE BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS
  sweep_period_s: 20.0                 # [PLACEHOLDER] duration of ONE directional pass (CW, then CCW, alternating); one reading per node per pass
  range_noise_sd_m: 0.03               # [PLACEHOLDER] Gaussian range noise sd
  quantisation_m: 0.01                 # [PLACEHOLDER] range quantisation step
  max_range_m: 40.0                    # [PLACEHOLDER] readings beyond this are "no return" (NaN)
  dwell_s: 1.5                         # [PLACEHOLDER] dwell per node; must be <= sweep_period_s / 4

comms:                           # LoRa as a packet / loss / latency process ONLY (no RF propagation)
  node_loss_prob: 0.01                 # [PLACEHOLDER] background per-packet loss, node links
  hub_loss_prob: 0.005                 # [PLACEHOLDER] background per-packet loss, hub (LiDAR) link
  latency_median_s: 0.4                # [PLACEHOLDER] lognormal base latency median
  latency_sigma_ln: 0.4                # [PLACEHOLDER]

confounder.content:
# Benign hard negatives for class 0 (SYNTHETIC / SIMULATION). ALL VALUES ARE [PLACEHOLDER].
# Rule: every benign amplitude and duration must be at least `margin_factor` times SMALLER than the
# minimum the future abnormal-vibration class will use; multi-node spread must be strictly smaller.
# `abnormal_reference` is a stand-in for that future class; update it when the class is defined.
margin_factor: 3.0

benign:
  temperature_drift:
    max_tilt_deg: 0.05           # peak slow drift per node (common-mode by nature: every node feels temperature,
                                 # so the node-spread margin does NOT apply; amplitude margin does)
  vibration_burst:               # wind or passing vehicle
    rms_add_max: 0.02            # added piezo_rms at burst peak (real piezo_rms p99 ~ 0.031)
    crest: 3.0                   # peak amplitude = crest * rms_add
    duration_s: [2.0, 8.0]
    max_nodes: 2                 # wind may touch 2 nodes (2nd at 0.6x); vehicle 1 node
    tilt_jitter_sd_deg: 0.05     # extra IMU jitter at burst peak
  harmless_spike:
    peak_max: 0.06               # piezo_peak spike (real piezo_peak p99 ~ 0.068)
    tilt_max_deg: 0.2
    max_count: 3
    max_nodes: 1

abnormal_reference:              # [PLACEHOLDER] lower bounds for the FUTURE abnormal-vibration class
  rms_add_min: 0.08
  duration_s_min: 30.0
  min_nodes: 3
  tilt_jitter_sd_deg_min: 0.15
  peak_min: 0.2

dataset.content:
# Dataset and windowing configuration (SYNTHETIC / SIMULATION).
# All splits are strictly AT THE RUN LEVEL (never by window).
# [USER-SPEC] = required by brief; [PLACEHOLDER] = synthetic design parameter.

master_seed: 20261117

windowing:
  window_s: 5.0                  # [USER-SPEC] 5 s simulated window
  overlap: 0.5                   # [USER-SPEC] 50% overlap (step = 2.5 s)
  min_label_overlap: 0.5         # [USER-SPEC] >=50% overlap gets event/fault class; (0, 0.5) -> "transition"
  long_horizon_windows: 12       # [USER-SPEC] slope of window mean tilt magnitude over last N windows
  lead_in_baseline_s: 30.0       # [PLACEHOLDER] observable lead-in window for feature baseline subtraction
  impulse_peak_thresh: 0.035     # [PLACEHOLDER] piezo_peak threshold to count a sample as an impulse

splits:                          # [USER-SPEC] runs per class in the headline splits
  train: 60
  val: 20
  test: 20

shifted_test:                    # [USER-SPEC] shifted-noise test set (new seeds, never used in train/val)
  runs_per_class: 15             # [PLACEHOLDER] 15 runs x 6 classes = 90 runs
  noise_multiplier_range: [1.5, 2.0]   # [USER-SPEC]
  node_bias_sd_deg: 0.12         # [PLACEHOLDER] shifted per-node static bias sd (vs 0.05 nominal)
  confounder_scale: 0.85         # [PLACEHOLDER] different confounder amplitude scale (<=1.0 preserves margin)
  confounder_n_bursts: 2         # [PLACEHOLDER] fixed 2 bursts per run

stress_set:                      # [USER-SPEC] combined conditions (~100 runs), reported separately
  n_runs: 100
  combos:
    - [gradual, sensor_fault]
    - [gradual, comm_fault]
    - [rapid, sensor_fault]
    - [rapid, comm_fault]
    - [abnormal_vibration, comm_fault]
    - [abnormal_vibration, sensor_fault]
    - [sensor_fault, comm_fault]

broad_basin_subset:              # [USER-SPEC] gradual & rapid with broad_basin_subset: true, reported separately
  runs_per_class: 20             # 20 gradual + 20 rapid = 40 runs

stratification:                  # [USER-SPEC] stratify gradual & rapid peak_tilt_deg across [0.05, 3.0]
  enabled: true                  # log-spaced strata within each split so weak events (SNR < 1) are guaranteed

abnormal_vibration:              # [PLACEHOLDER] strictly above confounder_default.yaml abnormal_reference
  rms_add_range: [0.09, 0.22]          # >= 0.08 min (confounder max 0.02 * 3 = 0.06)
  duration_s_range: [35.0, 90.0]       # >= 30.0 s min (confounder max 8.0 * 3 = 24.0)
  min_nodes: 3                         # >= 3 nodes (confounder max 2)
  tilt_jitter_sd_deg_range: [0.16, 0.35]  # >= 0.15 deg min (confounder max 0.05 * 3 = 0.15)
  impulse_peak_range: [0.22, 0.55]     # >= 0.20 min (confounder max 0.06 * 3 = 0.18)
  impulse_rate_per_s: 0.35
  crest: 3.2
  start_frac_range: [0.20, 0.45]

shape_mismatch.content:
# Model-mismatch stress test (SYNTHETIC / SIMULATION). ALL RANGES ARE PLACEHOLDERS, not calibrated to any site.
# The frozen v3 models were trained on Gaussian / elliptical basins only. These shapes are plausible-looking
# alternatives, NOT field data and NOT a validation.
seed_base: 3000000001        # new seeds, disjoint from every seed in outputs/datasets* (existing seeds ~2.026e9); asserted in code
seed_offsets: {gradual: 0, rapid: 100, normal: 200}   # seeds: base+offset+i

runs:
  gradual_per_shape: 30
  rapid_per_shape: 30
  normal_runs: 40            # shared by all shapes (null field, identical pipeline)

shapes: [gaussian_control, trough_panel, asymmetric, two_basin, planar_slope]

# Peak tilt (max surface slope anywhere) follows the SAME log-stratified draw for every shape (same seeds), range taken
# from configs/scenario_default.yaml ranges.peak_tilt_deg. Centre, theta, t_on, tau, mounting and sensor noise come from
# the same seed and are therefore identical across shapes (paired design); only the shape of w(x,y) differs.

trough_panel:                # PLACEHOLDER: Gaussian influence function integrated over a rectangular panel
  panel_width_radii: [0.8, 2.4]       # full width along x' (network radii; 1 radius = 14.14 m)
  panel_length_radii: [0.8, 2.4]      # full length along y'
  influence_sigma_radii: [0.15, 0.5]  # sigma of the influence function (edge softness)

asymmetric:                  # PLACEHOLDER: different spread on the two sides of the centre along x'
  skew_ratio: [1.5, 3.0]              # sigma(+x') / sigma(-x'); sigma(-x') = the base sx; sigma(+x') capped at 1.5 radii

two_basin:                   # PLACEHOLDER: two isotropic Gaussians (aspect ratio of the base basin is ignored)
  separation_sigma: [1.0, 3.0]        # centre separation in units of sigma1
  magnitude_ratio: [0.3, 1.0]         # basin 2 amplitude / basin 1 amplitude (basin 1 is the larger or equal)
  sigma2_over_sigma1: [0.6, 1.4]

planar_slope:                # PLACEHOLDER: uniform tilt plane, one direction, no convergence point
  direction_deg: [0.0, 360.0]         # downslope direction in the world frame

peak_search:                 # numerical search for max |grad h| (non-Gaussian shapes)
  step_fraction: 6.0                  # grid step = smallest length scale / this
  refine_halfwidth_steps: 2.0
